name: Nasledstvo
source:
An archaeology student and an occasional "digger" is up to his ears in problems. He has been duped by a buyer, urgently needs money and his only chance is to find a stash of scythian jewellery, hidden away in his grandfather's house.
Greedy relatives have already cleaned out the house and sold the land for an expanding nearby motor depot, but hope dies last, and there is still a whole day left before the demolition.
But is the house as simple as it looks at first glance?
And what will you do when the appliances talk to you?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/38-1-0-4137]Anivisual[/url]]
